title: ConfidenceObject
description: Standardized confidence assessment attached to any claim, output, or analysis produced within the Finance X platform.

level.description: Categorical confidence level. high=strong evidence, direct source data. medium=reasonable evidence, minor gaps. low=limited evidence, significant gaps or inferences. speculative=no direct evidence, scenario-only.

score.description: Optional numeric confidence score 0.0-1.0 mapped from level: high>=0.75, medium=0.50-0.74, low=0.25-0.49, speculative<0.25.

basis.description: Human-readable explanation of what grounds this confidence level. Must name the specific data sources or reasoning that support this rating.

limiting_factors.description: Explicit list of factors that prevent a higher confidence level.

impact.description: How much this factor degrades confidence.

propagation_notes.description: Notes on how this confidence should propagate to downstream consumers. E.g. 'downstream synthesis must not upgrade this confidence without additional evidence'.

data_vintage.description: Date of the most recent data underlying this confidence assessment (YYYY-MM-DD).

review_required.description: If true, a human or QA agent must review before this output is used in final reporting.
